about: Rankings: HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year (2011, 2013-2015) and Esports Earnings' 2012 CS:GO prize money. Configs come from public archives of pro CS:GO configs, mostly game-written config.cfg files in setup.gg's GitHub archive. A file is dated from the settings it contains, checked against Valve's release notes, or else from the archive's commit date as an upper bound; each page lists its sources and how each date is known.

years.note: A CS 1.6 ranking (CS:GO came out in August 2012), so these are the players' CS:GO configs from later, each labelled with its date.

config.date_basis: A full config.cfg in the game's own format, from setup.gg's archive (uploaded 29 Apr 2016). It has the scoreboard-mouse setting added 23 Apr 2014 but none of the cl_hud_* settings added 1 May 2014, so it was saved in late April 2014. Its crosshair style 5 was only added on 16 Jul 2014, so that line may be later.

years.ranking: Esports Earnings: top CS:GO prize-money earners of 2012
